attributes.name: Cloud Puff
attributes.powers:
Bury or banish this card to allow a character at your location to ignore a bane’s powers that happen before and after you act. After the check, you may succeed at a Craft 4 or Survival 5 check to recharge this card instead. 

While you reset your hand, reveal this card to ignore any cards that have the Plant trait in your hand when determining the number of cards in your hand.

corrections.corrected_text: On the item Cloud Puff, add the italicized text to the following sentence: "Bury or banish this card to allow a character at your location to ignore a bane’s powers that happen before and after you act."
